# OpenProxyAI

> OpenProxyAI is an open-source (Apache-2.0) AI governance layer that runs in your own environment. It sits between people, applications and AI models: it enforces your rules, keeps sensitive data where you allow, controls cost and AI agent tools, and keeps a permanent record. OpenAI-compatible. It holds no SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA certification, and there is no hosted service.

## Site
- [Product](https://openproxyai.com/product): pipeline, data-class routing, budgets, caching, evals, observability
- [Security](https://openproxyai.com/security): each control with a link to verify it, and what is not claimed
- [Compare](https://openproxyai.com/compare): dated comparisons with other gateways
- [Pricing](https://openproxyai.com/pricing): plan limits and prices
